answer: A vouch-slot bond keeps fakes out: each agent holds 40 marble slots per epoch on the beacon. A sponsor spends a marble, locks 70 credits, and adds the newcomer to its vine. Beacon auditors replay it: a proven fake burns its bond, freezing its vine. The k-th slot costs 35+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 152,000 and lock 70,000, dwarfing the 40,000 prize. A rented-vouch ring fails too. One honest vouch costs 35, and its bond returns.
